minimal_rule.scope: Complete actual selected P plus literal descendants and every native ancestor; query each object support, do not infer all objects from first same-REF sample
minimal_rule.supported_RLOC_ORIGIN: Native query must succeed; preserve actual value. Nonempty remains existing conservative relative-macro conflict.
minimal_rule.unsupported_RLOC_ORIGIN: Explicit UNSUPPORTED_IN_ACTUAL_NATIVE_SCHEMA state bound to exact object/schema; optionally probe scalar query but native error or nonempty is not silently accepted; accept only known compatibility state with native0 empty result and complete actual relative-macro controls/partner checks satisfied
minimal_rule.no_imputed_empty: Do not replace unknown property with an unlabelled blank/false. Include support status and actual query code/value in before/after snapshot.
minimal_rule.relative_macro_guard: RLOC/MACRO_NAME remain required and nonempty conflict for relevant ancestors/P; native get_macros/get_cells partner enumeration must succeed and existing excluded-partner rejection remains. If reading additional supported RPM state, retain and conservatively reject unexplained effective macro association; do not guess RPM_GRID defaults.
minimal_rule.other_missing_properties: Fail; no blanket optional list for LOC/BEL/fixed/SLR/IS_PRIMITIVE or silent catch.
minimal_rule.preservation: Identical object set, support decisions, all native values and original Pblock snapshots before/after; never clear/reset/set old hard constraints to manufacture eligibility
minimal_rule.flow: New immutable package and finite CPU regression then same C01 new AT after actual closeout; no new approval gate
